name: Under Maintenance
source:
After a rough day at work, all you want to do is settle in with your favorite otome game, only to realize it's gone down for maintenance. How will you pass these troubling times? Risk going to a watering hole to drown your sorrows in a beverage of choice? Begrudgingly scroll through a dating app to meet your love for the night? Either way - adventure, shenanigans, and hot singles in your area await!

[From [url=https://undermaintenancestudio.itch.io/under-maintenance]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过一天辛苦的工作后，你只想玩自己最喜欢的乙女游戏，却发现它因维护而停机了。你将如何度过这些令人不安的时期？冒险去酒吧喝一杯自选的饮料来浇灭悲伤吗？不情愿地浏览约会应用程序来满足你今晚的爱人？无论哪种方式 - 你所在地区的冒险、恶作剧和热门单身人士都在等待着你！

[来自[url=https://undermaintenancestudio.itch.io/under-maintenance]Itch.io[/url]]
